page.overview:
Who is Dial-Tone?

Dial-Tone is a young up and coming female Marine with brown hair and blue eyes. She explained to Flint how Cobra was blocking satellite communication while still allowing radio signals to get through. When the Flagg was targeted by Cobra's satellite weapon she informed Flint who ordered the crew to abandon ship. Flint personally got her off the ship and both barely escaped the ensuing tidal wave.
